weather_integration: A NASA POWER climatology endpoint exists in backend/app/services/weather_service.py with district baseline fallbacks. It returns climatological/annual summaries, not historical year- and season-aligned weather for 1997-2019, so it cannot be joined to training rows.

candidate_decisions.primary: Explicit yield in tonnes/ha plus area, crop, season, year, district, state, and Haryana/Punjab coverage.
candidate_decisions.not_combined: The remaining files have incompatible geography/time/schema, are overlapping/shorter extracts, or require source semantics/spatial matching not provided by the repository.
